frame_end_convention: Exclusive end frames; acceptable bound arrays are inclusive.
review_method: Every source frame around the first kick was reviewed from a dense contact sheet, and the source was played in QuickTime before this label was frozen. The label was made independently of Gemini output.
limitations: This is a development check for one endpoint-inspection mechanism, not held-out accuracy evidence.
One football kick cannot establish general movement-boundary accuracy.

cases.author: PK17 Football (PredatorKnuckles17) UK HD
cases.query: Show the complete first kick by the player in blue, including preparation and recovery.

activity.visible_evidence: The player in blue raises his leg and kicks the ball during one continuous wide camera shot.

expected.description: The established kick continues through visible recovery, then ends before unrelated waiting footage.
